title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 36
description: Ten questions on Psalms 36: the wicked who has no fear of God, and Yahweh's loving kindness that reaches to the heavens.

questions.text: According to verse 1, what is not before the eyes of the wicked?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says of the wicked, "There is no fear of God before his eyes."

questions.text: How does the wicked man treat himself in verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

answers.text: He despises himself in his own eyes
He flatters himself in his own eyes
He weeps bitterly over his sin

questions.text: Where does the wicked plot iniquity, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says he plots iniquity on his bed.

questions.text: What reaches to the skies in verse 5?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says, "Your faithfulness reaches to the skies."

questions.text: To what is Yahweh's righteousness compared in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says, "Your righteousness is like the mountains of God."

questions.text: Where do the children of men take refuge in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says the children of men take refuge under the shadow of God's wings.

answers.text: In the caves of the hills
Under the shadow of God's wings

questions.text: What will God make them drink of, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says, "You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures."

questions.text: What does verse 9 say is with God?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says, "For with you is the spring of life."

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask not to come against him in verse 11?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says, "Don't let the foot of pride come against me."

questions.text: What does verse 12 say about the workers of iniquity?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says they are fallen and thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

answers.text: They shall rule over the whole land
They are fallen and shall not be able to rise
They shall repent and be lifted up
